name: FENa (Fractional Excretion of Sodium)
template:
FENa (Fractional Excretion of Sodium)

Distinguishes prerenal from intrinsic acute kidney injury

Formula: FENa = (Urine Na × Serum Cr) / (Serum Na × Urine Cr) × 100
Interpretation:
• <1%: Prerenal azotemia (volume depletion, heart failure, cirrhosis)
• >2%: Intrinsic renal disease (ATN, interstitial nephritis)
• 1-2%: Indeterminate (consider clinical context)
Limitations:
• Not valid with diuretic use (use FEUrea instead)
• Less reliable in chronic kidney disease
• Post-obstructive diuresis can give false high values
